g.text: GP capital adds downside exposurealongside carry's upside incentive
GP capital strengthens alignment, but does not remove every conflict.
Actual compensation and loss sharing depend on fund terms, including applicable clawback provisions.
How do these mechanisms translate into LP cash flows and GP compensation?

Source: Case (roles of the parties; TPG's roughly $500m own commitment, p. 5); Metrick & Yasuda (2007); Preparation Questions Q2–Q3.Q3 uses the question's ten-year, $20bn, 20%-growth, 20%-carry model; its 15% discount rate is not a hurdle.
